kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem update-dataset-record --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --dataset-id dataset-10iy8mbifnb4gniv0000 --api-version 2024-12-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateDataSetRecord

parameters.help_en:
The region where the Data Management center for threat analysis is located. Select a region for the management center based on the region of your asset. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: The asset is in the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: The asset is in a region outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese.

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回消息的语言类型。取值：
zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The content of the dataset records, in JSON array format
parameters.help_zh: 数据集记录内容，json数组格式
parameters.name: dataset_records

parameters.help_en: The name of the uploaded dataset file
parameters.help_zh: 上传的数据集文件名称
parameters.name: dataset_file_name

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the member. An administrator can use this parameter to switch to the perspective of a specific member
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

DataSetRecordStatistic.description_en: The result of the dataset update

NewDataSetRecordCount.description_en: The number of new dataset records

UpdateDataSetRecordCount.description_en: The number of updated dataset records
